name: Mauricio Ruffy

face.shape: Long, rectangular-oval face with high, prominent cheekbones and hollow cheeks below them. The full beard extends the chin into a tapered point, so the whole head reads long and narrow at the bottom.
face.jaw: Lean and angular under the beard; the jaw angles are moderately wide and the beard follows them down to the chin.
face.chin: Medium width and moderately long; the beard is longest here and makes it look pointed.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, the strongest bone feature of the face, with clear hollows below (Lincoln Memorial close-up, studio headshot).
face.brow_ridge: Prominent and straight, so the eyes sit deep and shadowed.
face.forehead: Tall, fairly broad and smooth, with faint horizontal lines when he raises his brows (UFC 331 media day).

eyes.shape: Almond-shaped and fairly narrow, deep-set under the brow, with a slight hood on the upper lid. Outer corners level. His usual expression is a narrowed, intense stare.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Medium brown, amber-brown under strong light (studio headshot, Lincoln close-up). Closest embed iris: brownlight.

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, close to the eyes, with the inner ends set low and close together, which gives a stern look. Slight lift at the outer third.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, close to the hair colour.

nose.width: Medium bridge, widening to a slightly broad, rounded tip.
nose.bridge: Straight with a well-defined line from the brow (three-quarter views).
nose.tip: Rounded and slightly broad, level to slightly down.

mouth.upper_lip: Medium-thin, partly covered at the corners by the moustache.
mouth.lower_lip: Moderately full; it shows clearly below the moustache.
mouth.resting_expression: Lips closed and pressed, corners level or slightly down, matching the stare.

ears.protrusion: Stand out slightly; fully visible with the faded sides.
ears.cauliflower_ear: No. Both ears look smooth and normal in the studio headshot.

face.notable_marks_scars: No clear facial scars at these resolutions. Skin is smooth with a few faint marks on the forehead.

hair.style: Short faded sides (skin at the bottom, about 0.5 cm higher up) and a top of about 6 cm swept up and back into a quiff (studio photos June and Sept 2026, White House photos June 2026). At the UFC 331 weigh-in (Sept 2026) a hard part is shaved into the left side. Left natural (UFC 325 fight week, Jan 2026), the top falls into loose dark curls.
hair.colour: Dark brown, close to black in low light.
hair.hairline: Fairly straight front with slightly rounded, mildly receded temple corners. Full density on top.
hair.texture: Naturally curly to wavy (Jan 2026); usually styled smooth with product.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with a warm reddish-brown cast, a little lighter and warmer than the head hair, especially along the jaw.
facial_hair.density: Dense and even across the chin, jaw and moustache.
facial_hair.length_notes: About 2 cm on the cheeks and jaw, 3-4 cm at the chin in 2025-2026 photos.
facial_hair.shape: Full beard with a groomed, fairly sharp cheek line running from the sideburn down toward the corner of the moustache. Longest at the chin, tapering to a point (spade shape). Full moustache that reaches the lip corners and joins the beard.

skin.excluded_samples: Forehead samples hit highlights; the UFC 331 media-day 'beard' sample landed on the microphone.
skin.tone_note: The studio grade pushes orange and the Lincoln grade pushes grey-pink; the true tone sits between them.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible. Light leg hair; light hair on the forearms.

body.build: Rangy and long-limbed: 180 cm with a 190.5 cm reach, so the arms are long for his height. Lean, athletic striker's frame.
body.body_fat_notes: Visible six-pack and obliques in both 2026 studio cutouts; defined but not bulky.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad with defined, rounded delts.
body.chest: Moderately developed pecs, mostly covered by the chest piece.
body.arms: Long, lean arms with defined biceps and long forearms with visible veins.
body.waist: Narrow, with a clear taper from the chest.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs and moderate calves.
body.neck: Fairly long and of medium thickness.
body.posture: Upright with the chin slightly down and an intense, narrowed stare. In the studio cutouts his arms hang slightly away from the body, the right a little forward, elbows softly bent, gloves at hip height. Fights orthodox (left foot forward). The Freedom 250 fight photo shows a deep forward lunge into a long straight punch, rear heel up and torso leaning well forward. Weigh-in face-offs: fists up near the chin (UFC 331, Freedom 250).
body.notable_physique_traits: Long arms and legs on a lean frame; the large chest piece and left-arm sleeve against a bare right arm.

tattoos.where: Chest, across both pecs from the collarbones to just below the nipples
tattoos.description: Large black-and-grey piece. Over his LEFT pec: an anime-style figure with spiky hair and a wide grin, one fist raised, drawn like manga art. Across the upper sternum: the word 'Ruffy' in gothic lettering. Over his RIGHT pec: dark brushstroke and ink-splash shapes, lines like chains or rope, and some light unshaded outlines near the collarbone. Brush strokes run onto the front of the right shoulder.
tattoos.size: About 35 cm wide x 22 cm tall

tattoos.where: Left arm, sleeve from the shoulder to the wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey sleeve. Upper arm: a woman's face with closed eyes wearing an owl headdress, framed by dark shading with light dot circles. At the elbow: an elephant head drawn with geometric line work. Outer forearm: a skull wearing a crown above a pocket-watch face with Roman numerals. Inner forearm: further shaded imagery that is not clear in these photos.

tattoos_note: His right arm is bare in both studio cutouts. His back is not visible. The chest figure may refer to his nickname, but the character is not identified here.
accessories_seen: Heavy gold chain with a gold pendant (Paris 2025 media day); thin silver chain with a green pendant (UFC 331 weigh-in); thin chain and a red string bracelet on one wrist (Freedom 250 weigh-in).

kit.typical_shorts: UFC Freedom 250 (June 2026): white shorts with red diagonal stripes down his right side and light-blue stripes on the left, a navy waistband with white stars and a UFC wordmark, crypto.com logo on the right thigh; red Freedom 250 gloves with a US-flag patch. UFC 331 (Sept 2026): white UFC shorts with a light-grey scalloped print, a black front waistband panel with a white UFC wordmark, a white-and-black checker band, and green lettering on the left thigh (not legible). Weigh-ins: sand-coloured UFC sweat shorts (UFC 331), navy shorts with red drawcords (Freedom 250).
kit.gloves: Red Freedom 250 gloves (June 2026); standard black UFC studio gloves otherwise; corner-coloured cuffs on fight night.
kit.brand_note: No apparel brand is legible; describe them as UFC-issued.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: Ear targets live in assets/embed/mh-shapes-x.bin.gz (not mh-manifest.json); avatar3d.js reads this block.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 (the fuller one), tinted #2e211b, set low and straight
render_hints.hair: about 6 cm on top swept up and back, faded sides, tinted #2e211b
render_hints.beard: full beard 2-4 cm with a tapered chin point and a sharp cheek line, colour #4a3022
render_hints.tattoos: large chest piece and left-arm sleeve; right arm bare

notes: Confidence: high for hair, beard, tattoos, build and kit; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 13 photos (5 Commons public domain from June 2026, 8 reference-only, all but one from 2026), so coverage is strong; the public-domain Lincoln Memorial close-up is the best face reference. A clean side profile is missing; the closest are near-profiles of his LEFT side in the UFC 331 face-off and the UFC 325 weigh-in frame stored under rafael-fiziev/ (ref-ufc325-weighin-2026-01-30.jpg). No right-side profile. What to watch: (1) High cheekbones, deep-set narrowed eyes under thick low brows, and a long tapered beard make the face; keep the beard pointed, not boxy. (2) Long arms (reach 10 cm over height) and long legs on a lean frame. (3) Tattoo sides: the chest piece's grinning figure is over his LEFT pec, the sleeve is on the LEFT arm, and the right arm is bare. (4) Orthodox: left foot forward, power right hand; he commits to deep forward lunges on straight punches. (5) Hair is dark and usually slicked into a quiff over faded sides. Macro values: ageOldM uses avatar3d.js's (age-25)/65 mapping (age 30). heightUpM 0.1 is a guess for 180.3 cm; scale to the official height. MakeHuman l-/r- morphs refer to the character's own left and right.
